children: China textile maker's half-year revenue fell yr/yr, net loss narrowed slightly
Company posted RMB 22.9 mln net loss attributable to owners for the period
Lower gross profit and continued administrative expenses weighed on results
Company says expected that revenue performance in the second half to outperform that of the first half
WEAKER INNERWEAR DEMAND – Revenue fell 14.6% as weak customer demand cut innerwear sales volume to 13.6 mln pieces from 15.7 mln
LOWER FABRIC PRICING – Knitted-fabric revenue fell 17.0% as a higher share of lower-priced dyeing and printing subcontracting orders reduced average selling prices
